prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup. Make one high-fidelity Chinese Android photo gallery time-sort design proposal, portrait 1080x2424 aspect, straight-on flat screenshot. Reference image 1 is the app's EXISTING album layout and strict visual authority for warm-paper #FAFAF8, charcoal #25241F, typography, date grouping, large two-column photography masonry, source tabs and floating nav. Reference image 2 is ONLY the user-approved B translucent bottom filter-panel MATERIAL and small control language; do NOT copy its preset home or its filter labels. Keep album home. This is design only, not an implemented screenshot.
Preserve image 1 existing hierarchy and positions closely: compact system bar, "相册" title with existing search and more actions, source tabs exact "应用相册" selected / "手机相册", one existing summary row, grouped photo masonry with the same mountains/lake/café/forest photographic subjects, bottom nav exact "预设 同步 相册 设置" with whole third icon+label selected dark. Do NOT redesign the header, make three columns, shrink photography, rename tabs, add a banner or add an extra permanent toolbar row.
Only add a TINY CUSTOM sorting control in the existing summary row, between muted count "共 12 张" at left and the existing small "选择" action at right. Sorting control exact label "拍摄 ↓", 12-13sp equivalent, small low-contrast warm grey capsule painted height 30dp within invisible 48dp touch target. Keep count, sort and selection aligned on one baseline and separated 8dp, not touching. Keep date group heading exact "11月9日" and small count "8 张" on the same baseline. This is the screen with time sort popup already OPEN so entry AND photo context remain visible.
Overlay one bespoke bottom FLOATING translucent white glass sheet, reference 2 material, just 12dp from screen sides and 14dp above bottom safe inset. CONTENT HEIGHT ONLY, about 235-255dp: deliberately shorter than the preset filter panel. Temporarily covers existing navigation without moving underlying content. Soft warm milky true backdrop blur, faint underlying photograph color, delicate inner highlight and restrained shadow; light background scrim only. No dark screen or oversized black region.
Sheet layout: tiny centered grabber at top. Header exact title "时间排序", medium weight 16sp equivalent aligned left and small close x at right. First muted small section label exact "排序依据" at 12sp. Below a single row of TWO INDIVIDUAL, well-separated compact capsules exact "拍摄时间" and "添加时间"; select "拍摄时间" with charcoal and white text plus a tiny trailing check. 36dp painted height, 48dp target. 8dp gap, no joined selected regions. Second section label exact "排列顺序"; below same TWO individual capsules exact "新到旧" and "旧到新"; select "新到旧" charcoal/white and tiny check. Body option text 13sp. All selections concentric, exact spacing, equal heights, one-line labels, no native Android radio buttons or system dialog. Footer just below with 12dp spacing: small text "重置" at left and restrained 88x36dp charcoal pill "应用" at right on one baseline. No giant full width CTA, no extra description paragraphs, no preview card, no legends or decorative tags.
Make the existing photos dominate the upper two-thirds, keep typography quiet and all controls proportional. Preserve the album content geometry; only sort entry and temporary sheet are new. Render exact Simplified Chinese text legibly. No phone hardware frame, no perspective, no side-by-side board, no watermark or explanations outside screen.
